svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 06 · Merced · 11/12 Toward Yosemite (Common)
svg.desc: Head east and the road starts climbing into the foothills. The granite is somewhere up ahead. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
